newsitem.title: ROMANIA: NINE-MONTH HARBOUR FREIGHT 16.9 PCT UP IN ROMANIA.
newsitem.headline: NINE-MONTH HARBOUR FREIGHT 16.9 PCT UP IN ROMANIA.

text.p: The volume of Romanian domestic harbour freight transport went up by 16.9 percent in the first nine months of 1996 from the equivalent period of last year, a National Statistics Board report showed on Monday.
It said maritime freight accounted for 64 percent of the total nine-month volume of 43.6 million tonnes. The rest was river transport.
Crude oil took about 25 percent of January-September maritime freight, while iron ore and scrap iron took 46.8 percent of river transportation.
The report said the state sector accounted for 51.5 of maritime transport, while the private sector had a small 2.4 percent stake. The rest was taken by companies partly owned by the state.
The state sector had a 98.6 percent share in January- September river freight transport. -- Luli Popescu, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
